title: Apply for a Road Occupancy Licence
summary: Apply for a Road Occupancy Licence online if you need to conduct activities, such as construction work or fixing potholes, that will impact an arterial road.
intro:
If you need to apply for a Road Occupancy Licence to conduct activities like fixing pot holes or construction work that is likely to have an impact on the operations of an arterial road (for example, a traffic lane closure), you can do this via the Online PLanned INCident System (OPLINC).
